observations.scored_object: the Overview expanded, with its source cards

reached.span: Frameworks like Autonomous Semantic Warfare: A Field Manual for Meaning in the Age of Platform Capture by Rex Fraction analyze how networked platforms extract meaning-production capacity from users
reached.basis: The Field Manual reached by its full title and its author, as one of three core components; the address's lead definition gives the term in its tool and combatant roles (agents generating narratives), without the field role.

atoms.span: Autonomous Semantic Warfare: A Field Manual for Meaning in the Age of Platform Capture

observations.notes: Author and title present, in the third bullet. Claim boundary narrowed in the lead: agents generating narratives, the 'Autonomous Narrative Warfare' of the Homeland Security Today card, is set as the term's whole definition; it is the manual's tool and combatant roles (#499, ch. 8), and the field role drops, so that the manual's account (platform capture, extraction of meaning-production capacity, 'structured battlegrounds of incompatible worldviews') stands as one framework under it. Purpose (ending semantic warfare by a Semantic Ecology) and commitments absent. The registry's capture page of 2026-06-15 is card 4, its snippet the earlier Overview's same opening.
